shortDescription: GREAT NECK, N.Y., Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Manhattan Bridge Capital, Inc. (Nasdaq: LOAN) (the “Company”) announced that its Board of Directors has approved an increase in the aggregate number of shares authorized for repurchase under its existing common share repurchase program from 250,00…

children: ) (the “Company”) announced that its Board of Directors has approved an increase in the aggregate number of shares authorized for repurchase under its existing common share repurchase program from 250,000 to 500,000 common shares. All other terms and conditions of the share repurchase program, including its expiration date of October 9, 2027, remain unchanged.
The manner, timing and number of shares purchased will be at the Company’s discretion.

Assaf Ran, Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer stated, “I’m not sure what’s causing this significant drop in our stock price recently, but I definitely see that as an opportunity for the Company to buy back shares.”

Manhattan Bridge Capital, Inc. offers short-term secured, non–banking loans (sometimes referred to as ‘‘hard money’’ loans) to real estate investors to fund their acquisition, renovation, rehabilitation or improvement of properties located in the New York metropolitan area, including New Jersey and Connecticut, and in Florida.
